messages.subject: Middle East Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Jack,

Your Middle East leadership role at ONE SEARCH across infrastructure, energy transition and real assets makes this a focused introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE where infrastructure and energy growth depend on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
